rueckkehr.untertitel: You were away for {tage} days — Gooby is over the moon that you're here again!

story.fenster: Gooby sat by the window every day, watching out for you.
story.kissen: Gooby fluffed every pillow — several times. Best to be prepared.
story.staub: Gooby chased a dust bunny. The dust bunny won.
story.garten: Gooby checked on the garden beds, nodding very importantly.
story.ranch: Gooby visited the ranch and told the horses all about you.
story.ball: Gooby threw the ball and then fetched it himself. Both jobs.
story.kuehlschrank: Gooby looked inside the fridge VERY often. Just looking, honest.
story.radio: Gooby listened to the radio and hummed along to your favorite song.
story.fotos: Gooby looked through your photos together and sniffled a little.
story.arcade: Gooby secretly practiced for the arcade. His record? Classified.

rueckkehr.quest_hinweis: No rush at all — Gooby loves every little moment:

aufgabe.rk_fuettern: Give Gooby something tasty to eat
aufgabe.rk_spielen: Play one round together in the arcade

rueckkehr.belohnung: A reunion gift waits at the end: +{muenzen} coins and +{xp} XP.
rueckkehr.fertig_toast: All settled back in! +{muenzen} coins, +{xp} XP 💛
